company.shortDescription: Salt AI is a contextual AI company that offers a visual development platform for enterprise applications in life sciences and health tech.
company.description: Salt AI is a contextual AI company that offers a visual development platform for enterprise applications in life sciences and health tech. The company's platform enables research and healthcare teams to integrate, visualize, and deploy AI models. From protein generation and biomarker discovery to clinical evidence synthesis and diagnostics, the company combines enterprise-grade scalability with a visual-first interface, empowering cross-functional teams to accelerate discovery and innovation.
